description: Check a Bitcoin mainnet BOLT11 invoice against the exact amount, expected payee public key and minimum time remaining before you approve payment. Paid per call. Price: 8 sats or US$0.008 (USDC) per call.

invoice_policy.description: invoice|expected_msat|min_remaining_seconds|payee_public_key. Seconds 0–86400. Enter the payee's 66-character Lightning public key.

pay_with.description: Optional. 'lightning' requests a BOLT11 invoice and a token when Diamond can receive Lightning payments.
